'''2015 European Championship Day 3 Jimmy Faelens DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jimmy Faelens]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
